prod.run: set GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0&& set GCM_INTERACTIVE=never&& git fetch --quiet origin && git merge --ff-only {ref} && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\deploy.ps1 -Ref {ref}
prod.how: CarbonBoard (soundboard, virtual-mic passthrough, audio profiles, tray) on MAINGAMINGRIG. Fast-forwards C:\Programming\CarbonBoard to the named commit (never backwards; refuses a dirty tracked tree), builds it (next build + tsc + electron-builder --dir), keeps resources\app.asar.previous, swaps app.asar and app.asar.unpacked into the installed app and starts it in the desktop session. Verified when main.log says ready after the start and :9502 answers; otherwise the previous build is restored. The virtual mic drops for the few seconds CarbonBoard is restarting. Does not touch the Stream Deck plugin (streamdeck/), whose install is separate.
